info.name: AI IT Incident Classifier - Cloud Validation
info.description:
Postman collection for validating the AI IT Incident Classifier API deployed on Cloud Run.

The collection uses variables for the Cloud Run base URL, reusable incident payloads and dynamic incident IDs. It validates runtime endpoints, classification contracts, request validation errors and BigQuery-backed incident history endpoints.

Recommended mode for routine validation: CLASSIFIER_PROVIDER=mock on Cloud Run to avoid unnecessary Gemini API usage. Gemini can be validated separately with a small number of requests after switching the Cloud Run service to CLASSIFIER_PROVIDER=gemini.
